text: {"findings":[{"rule_id":"MF-005","evidence":[{"kind":"title_block","ref":"heat_treatment","page":1,"quote":"---"}],"comment":"The title block heat treatment field is '---', yet note N3 on page 1 specifies case hardening to 55~60 HRC with a 0.8~1.2 mm case depth and threads kept soft. Leaving the title block blank risks the part being manufactured without the required heat treatment; the designer should update the heat_treatment field to reference the requirements in N3.","recommended_correction":"Update the title block heat_treatment field to reflect the case hardening specified in N3, or move the full specification into the title block."},{"rule_id":"WPS-004","evidence":[{"kind":"note","ref":"N5","page":1,"quote":"# FINISH: I.Z.B.P. (TRIVALENT)"},{"kind":"dimension","ref":"D11","page":1,"quote":"20"},{"kind":"note","ref":"N3","page":1,"quote":"4) RETAPPING TO BE DONE AFTER SURFACE TREATMENT AT SUPPLIER END.( IF APPLICABLE )"}],"comment":"Note N5 calls for zinc plating (I.Z.B.P.) and feature F1 defines an M16 thread dimensioned by D11, but no allowance for plating thickness is shown on the thread dimensions. Plating buildup will cause mating interference unless the thread is cut undersize before plating or retapped after; while N3 mentions retapping after surface treatment, it is qualified with '( IF APPLICABLE )' rather than being a firm requirement. The designer should either specify a pre-plate thread tolerance that accounts for coating thickness or make post-plate retapping mandatory.","recommended_correction":"Add a pre-plate thread tolerance class accounting for plating thickness, or change N3 item 4 to mandate retapping after plating without the 'IF APPLICABLE' qualifier."}]}
